name: Biomedical Life Sciences (VIBRE) PhD
detailsNote: Current VIBRE structure replaces legacy coordinated programs beginning September 2026. Available annual admissions date; Fall 2027 year not explicitly attached. The opened curriculum establishes the Metabolism track rotation route; a uniform model across all tracks is not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application and all supporting materials
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual fall entry; no spring admission. Current page does not attach entry year.

applicationFee.note: Need route restricted to US citizens/permanent residents currently enrolled at US college/university, with signed aid-officer EFC letter; current US military category also listed. Email before submitting. No general overseas hardship waiver offered.

english.toefl: 100 before January 21, 2026; 5.5 after that date, as published
english.note: Two-year TOEFL/IELTS; based on undergraduate institution country, not citizenship. Two years study plus bachelor in US/English-official country exempts. English-country master alone does not exempt, but prior qualifying score copy may satisfy. No DET route stated by VIBRE. MyBest accepted per FAQ.

requirements.note: Faculty committee holistic assessment; no specific subject prerequisites stated in FAQ. Prior related doctorate or majority of doctorate completed elsewhere makes applicant ineligible; transfers not accepted. International official records after admission: secure institutional delivery or WES course-by-course ICAP if secure delivery unavailable; PRC uses specified verification. The Metabolism and Nutrient Biology track describes at least three first-year rotations of about three months and formal track selection at year end; other tracks not verified. Complete supporting materials required by deadline.

funding.note: All VIBRE PhDs receive tuition/university fees, student health and medical insurance including eligible dependent premiums. Optional dental 75% premium covered. Published FY 2026–27 stipend at least$50,008; not a future-year promise.
